column1: # The WHOLE phrase, not a bare 木头. 收集 is already a fragment ("Collect"), so
# it consumed the front and left "Collect木头" on screen. 木头 occurs exactly
# once in the entire game source - here - so a standalone entry for it would be
# a fragment that can only ever fire inside this one phrase anyway.
# Longest-first ordering is what makes this beat the bare 收集.
在荒兽森林中砍伐柳木
砍伐密林的云霄一阶树妖
